features.what: One-time password sign-in can be set separately for company and individual profiles per event through a single email-first login form, and admin accounts have a phone field for use in emails.
features.detail: Organisers set one-time password authentication independently for company and individual profiles per event, and admin accounts gain a phone field.
stories: Independent OTP Authentication Configuration for Company and Individual Profiles in Events
Phone field for Admins

features.title: Trusted embed domains
features.benefit: Embed authenticated content such as on-demand sessions on approved partner sites.
features.what: A security settings section in event setup lets organisers add and remove trusted external domains, so authenticated content such as on-demand sessions plays when embedded on those sites.
features.detail: A security settings section lets organisers whitelist trusted external domains so authenticated content plays when embedded there.
stories: Whitelist Trusted Embed Domains for Authenticated Iframe Content
